title: Documentation & Technical Evidence

major_finding.description: several core docs (08_AI.md, 05_API.md's internal AI section, 09_BLOCKCHAIN.md, 03_ARCHITECTURE.md's ADR-002/data-flow rules, 11_DEPLOYMENT.md's backup/CI sections, README.md, top-level repo structure claims) described an early pre-implementation plan that was never built and never reconciled with the real P5-P8 system
examples: 08_AI.md described a classification/forecasting/fraud ai/app/ service with /internal/classify endpoints; the real service is intelligence/device_ai/, confirmed ai/app/main.py is a 0-byte stub from the first commit
09_BLOCKCHAIN.md listed a fictional chaincode function list; verified the real 9-function contract directly against ecotrace-lifecycle.ts source
03_ARCHITECTURE.md's ADR-002 claimed backend is the sole Fabric client; verified blockchain.service.ts holds no Fabric connection at all -- the Python AI service is the real Gateway client (P6.2)
11_DEPLOYMENT.md described scheduled backups/rehearsed restores/a runbooks directory that do not exist anywhere in the repo (verified by search)
11_DEPLOYMENT.md claimed no CI workflow existed; a real .github/workflows/backend-ci.yml already existed, undocumented

README.md and 03_ARCHITECTURE.md pointed at ai/, dashboard/, database/, deployment/, testing/ as the real implementation; verified these are empty or stub directories, real code lives in backend/, frontend/, intelligence/device_ai/, mobile/, blockchain/chaincode/
major_finding.root_cause_classification: genuine, disclosed documentation defect from early planning docs never reconciled with what shipped; not introduced by P8, fixed because P8.9 mandates documentation not claim non-existent features

regression_suite.note: no application source touched this phase; unchanged from P8.8

environmental_limitations: 4 docs/engineering files not deep-audited this phase, disclosed not claimed clean
Device Lifecycle Flow sequence diagram in 03_ARCHITECTURE.md left as an illustrative target flow rather than rewritten to the real two-system split, a bounded scope decision
unused scaffold directories (ai/, dashboard/, database/, deployment/, testing/) disclosed but not deleted -- out of scope for a documentation phase
